For a European conversion, the **usual soft-brand shortlist** is:

| Hotel positioning | Commonly considered collections / soft brands |
|---|---|
| **Luxury** | **The Luxury Collection** by Marriott; **Vignette Collection** by IHG; **Emblems Collection** by Accor; **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**; **LXR Hotels & Resorts** by Hilton; **WorldHotels Luxury** |
| **Upper-upscale / premium lifestyle** | **Autograph Collection** and **Tribute Portfolio** by Marriott; **Curio Collection by Hilton**; **MGallery** by Accor; **JdV by Hyatt**; **Radisson Individuals**; **WorldHotels Elite** or **WorldHotels Crafted** |
| **Upscale / upper-midscale** | **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**; **Handwritten Collection** by Accor; **Radisson Individuals**; **Ascend Hotel Collection** by Choice; **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**; **WorldHotels Distinctive** |
| **Highly design-led independents** | **Design Hotels**, which operates as a curated affiliation rather than a conventional franchise soft brand and has links to Marriott Bonvoy at participating hotels |
| **Midscale or regional portfolios** | **Series by Marriott**, particularly where an owner wants to preserve an existing regional brand or portfolio identity |

Marriott formally positions **The Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection and Tribute Portfolio** as its collection-brand platform for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) Hilton’s principal established European options are **Curio** at upper-upscale and **Tapestry** at upscale, both of which are actively used for European conversions and resorts. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/hilton-expands-resorts-portfolio-with-new-signings-in-premier-mediterranean-destinations?utm_source=openai)) Accor provides an especially broad European ladder: **Handwritten Collection**, **MGallery** and **Emblems Collection**, from midscale through luxury. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai))

### Other options frequently evaluated

- **IHG Vignette Collection** for luxury independents where preserving the hotel’s identity is central. IHG also uses **voco** extensively for European conversions, although voco is a conventional conversion-friendly brand rather than a true soft brand. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-resorts-debuts-9-brands-in-13-countries-across-europe?utm_source=openai))
- **Hyatt Unbound** for premium-to-luxury landmark properties and **JdV by Hyatt** for smaller, neighborhood-oriented lifestyle hotels. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124136&utm_source=openai))
- **Radisson Individuals**, often relevant in continental Europe where Radisson’s sales presence and owner relationships are strong. It is explicitly structured to let hotels retain their name and identity. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/media/press-releases/rhg-launches-new-brand-radisson-individuals?utm_source=openai))
- **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Crafted and Distinctive**, particularly for owners seeking a lighter-touch affiliation with an established European footprint. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/content/luxury-hotels/en_US/brands.html?utm_source=openai))
- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Small Luxury Hotels of the World and Leading Hotels of the World** for luxury properties wanting distribution, marketing and loyalty support without taking a conventional hotel-company franchise. These are generally viewed as consortium or membership alternatives rather than full soft-brand franchises. ([slh.com](https://slh.com/contact-us?utm_source=openai))

### Newer options to monitor

As of **August 2026**, two newer platforms may enter owner discussions but have less European operating history:

- **Noted Collection by IHG** — a premium collection launched in February 2026, initially rolling out across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Africa. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2026/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-unveils-new-premium-collection-brand-noted-collection?utm_source=openai))
- **Series by Marriott** — a flexible midscale/upscale collection available in Europe, designed in part for established regional brands and multi-hotel portfolios. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/seriesbymarriott?utm_source=openai))

In practice, the most frequent competitive sets are **Autograph vs. Curio vs. MGallery** for upper-upscale hotels; **Luxury Collection vs. Vignette vs. Emblems vs. Unbound** for luxury assets; and **Tribute vs. Tapestry vs. Handwritten vs. Radisson Individuals** for upscale conversions. The final choice usually turns on market availability, loyalty-program contribution, PIP cost, territorial protection, franchise term, system fees and how much control the owner wants to retain over the hotel’s name, design, F&B and operating standards.
